reasoning: Israel is confirmed to participate in Eurovision 2026 with Noam Bettan representing them. Historical context shows Israel has won 4 times (1978, 1979, 1998, 2018) out of many participations - roughly a 4/50+ win rate historically. Recent performance shows strong public support (Eden Golan 2nd in public vote 2024, Yuval Raphael won public vote 2025) but weaker jury scores. With 35 countries participating and jury votes now carrying more weight, plus ongoing controversy and boycotts from 5 countries, Israel faces challenges. Base rate for any country winning is ~3%, but Israel's recent public vote strength suggests slightly higher odds.
